summary: Russian forces conducted drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, including a metallurgical plant in Kryvoy Rog with casualties. Wildberries warehouses in Podolsk and Domodevovo were targeted, causing fires. Moscow faced drone attacks overnight.
key_points: Russian forces struck a metallurgical plant in Kryvoy Rog, damaging energy and blast furnace facilities with 2 dead and 13 injured (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32503).
Wildberries warehouses in Podolsk and Domodevovo caught fire after Russian drone attacks (Source: @tass_agency/390515, @tass_agency/390519).
Over 800 Ukrainian drones were intercepted by Russian air defense systems overnight (Source: @tass_agency/390513).
Drone strikes targeted Moscow and its surrounding regions, causing fires in warehouses (Source: @UkraineNow/83455).
Russian strikes damaged a Wildberries logistics hub in Kolyadino (Source: @eRadarrua/105612).
A Ferrari electric car auction in Russia highlighted economic activity amid conflict (Source: @tass_agency/390549).
Ukrainian naval forces attacked a Russian Bastion missile complex in Crimea (Source: @UkraineNow/83461).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating attacks on Ukrainian industrial and logistical targets, focusing on metallurgical plants and Wildberries warehouses. The use of drones and missiles suggests a coordinated effort to disrupt supply chains and infrastructure. The high frequency of strikes indicates a sustained offensive strategy.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian forces have responded with naval strikes on Russian missile complexes in Crimea and counter-drone operations. Western allies are reportedly developing alternative negotiation frameworks due to concerns over U.S. involvement, which may influence regional security dynamics.
sections.intelligence_notes: The repeated targeting of Wildberries warehouses and metallurgical plants suggests these are high-priority targets for Russian forces. The interception of over 800 drones highlights the scale of Ukrainian drone operations. The focus on Kryvoy Rog and Kharkiv regions indicates a strategic emphasis on industrial and logistical hubs.
